title: Welcome to v2
description: This is the new i18n v2 API demo
features: Auto-scan locale files using Vite glob imports
Lazy loading by namespace - load translations on-demand
Full SSR support with preloaded translations

faqs.question: What is @shelchin/i18n?
faqs.answer: A lightweight i18n library for Svelte 5 with SSR support.

faqs.question: Does it support TypeScript?
faqs.answer: Yes! Full type safety with auto-generated types.
